map.建筑面积 = 套内面积 + 公摊面积；公摊系数 = 公摊面积 ÷ 套内面积；得房: Gross floor area = internal area + shared area; shared coefficient = shared area ÷ internal area; usable ratio = internal area ÷ gross floor area × 100%

Gross area = inner area + shared area; share coefficient = shared area ÷ inner area; efficiency rate = inner area ÷ gross area × 100%. Allocation can be equal per unit (assuming identical inner areas) or pro rata by each unit’s inner area ÷ total inner area.

map.没有按建筑类型统一规定的“正常区间”。规范主要规定哪些部位计入、如何测算与分摊；: There is no unified “normal range” by building type. Standards mainly define which components are included and how to measure and allocate; the ratio varies with building type, height, component scope and local survey rules. If it looks excessive, check each component against the survey report and follow local rules and the licensed surveyor’s conclusion.
map.均分和按套内比例有什么区别？: What is the difference between equal split and pro rata by inner area?
map.均分假设每户套内面积相同，只适合户型一致的粗略测算；按套内面积比例按每户套内占总: Equal split assumes every unit has the same inner area and is only suitable for a rough estimate when layouts are uniform. Pro rata allocation uses each unit’s share of total inner area, closer to common survey practice. The page can switch methods and list per-unit results.
map.逐项校验空值与合法零面积：套内总面积须大于 0，户数须为正整数，部位面积可填 0: Blank and valid zero areas are checked separately: total inner area must exceed 0, unit count must be a positive integer, and component areas may be 0 but may not be blank or negative. When total shared area is 0, shares show “N/A”. Equal split is only an assumption; pro rata by inner area is closer to surveyed practice, but the licensed survey report and local rules prevail.
